mandate: C352 — test the cross-sectional intraday local-Whittle EXACT MLE fractional integration order d x SEASONAL-DISLOCATION mean-reversion stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|. Local-Whittle metric over fixed intrinsic window W=256 bars ending at bar t, Fourier frequencies λ_j=2πj/W, j=1..127: demean window, periodogram I(λ_j)=|FFT[j]|² via np.fft.rfft, bounded scalar minimization d_hat=argmin_d over d in [-0.5,0.5] of log(Ŝ(d)) − d·mean_j log(4 sin²(λ_j/2)) with Ŝ(d)=(1/m)·Σ_j I(λ_j)·exp(d·log(4 sin²(λ_j/2))); lw_abs=|lw|. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 2 real (lw_dev, lw_abs_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs/denominator requirements (t<W=256).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 bars ending at t: demean window; periodogram I(λ_j)=|FFT[j]|² via np.fft.rfft, j=1..127 (exclude DC j=0 and Nyquist); local-Whittle d_hat=argmin_d over d in [-0.5,0.5] of log(Ŝ(d)) − d·mean_j log(4 sin²(λ_j/2)), Ŝ(d)=(1/m)·Σ_j I(λ_j)·exp(d·log(4 sin²(λ_j/2))); lw_abs=|lw|.
methodology.signals: lw/lw_abs over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.lw_invariance_note: The local-Whittle periodogram uses the demeaned window; subtracting the window mean removes the DC component (j=0) which is excluded anyway, so the criterion over j=1..127 is unchanged by a constant-per-bar mean shift. Validated against brute force in tests.
